The Todo app is complete at `todo_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html` (457 lines, single self-contained file with inline CSS and JS).

**Requirements implemented:**

- **Add new todos** — text input with Add button and Enter-key support; empty/whitespace input is rejected.
- **Mark complete (strikethrough)** — each item has a checkbox; the `.completed` class applies `text-decoration: line-through` to the label.
- **Delete todos** — per-item `×` button removes it from the list.
- **Filter All / Active / Completed** — `.filters` buttons set `state.filter`; `getFiltered()` returns the matching subset and the active button is highlighted.
- **Persist to localStorage** — `save()` writes `{todos, filter}` under key `todos-app-v1` on every mutation; `load()` restores and sanitizes it on startup (with try/catch for unavailable storage).

Extras that came with the build: an items-left counter, a "Clear completed" button (disabled when nothing is completed), and context-aware empty states for each filter.

- **Persist to localStorage** — `save()` writes `{todos, filter}` under key `todos-app-v1` on every mutation; `load()` restores and sanitizes it on startup (with try/catch for unavailable storage).
